title: Stop arguing with what already stands
summary: Peace begins where argument with Hukam starts ending. Receive what already stands before resistance starts rehearsing itself again.
lifeApplication: When the chest hardens against reality, return to Hukam before reaction chooses the tone.

source.shortMeaning: Peace begins where argument with Hukam starts ending.
source.lifeApplication: Before you argue with the moment again, stop and name what is already here.

evidence.coreClaim: Peace begins where argument with Hukam starts ending.
evidence.turn: Carry this with you: learn to receive under the Lord's pleasure rather than argue with it.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the chest hardens against reality, return to Hukam before reaction chooses the tone.
